rationale: The carrier's confirmation shows the flight left 7 hours 5 minutes after its scheduled departure (09:15 to 16:20), which is shorter than the 12-hour waiting period on the Economy plan. Under section 3 of the policy wording (Trip Delay) and section 1 (waiting period), the delay benefit is not triggered, so the meal and lounge costs of $123.00 are not payable. The claim was filed in time and no other exclusion was needed to decide it.
